newsitem.title: USA: Chrysler Q4 production rises 1.4 percent.
newsitem.headline: Chrysler Q4 production rises 1.4 percent.

text.p: Chrysler Corp said it produced about 709,000 cars and trucks worldwide during the fourth quarter of 1996, up 1.4 percent from the 699,400 units it built during the same period of 1995.
The fourth quarter production was 3,500 units above Chrysler's most recent estimate, released about a month ago.
Chrysler said its total worldwide production for the full 1996 year came to 2,864,091 cars and trucks, 14.9 percent above the 2,491,925 units produced in 1995.
